payload.goal: Run payroll for employee Arne Aasen for the current month with base salary 42450 NOK and one-time bonus 13850 NOK.
success_checks: Employee Arne Aasen exists with email arne.aasen@example.org
Payroll-capable setup/module is enabled or available
A payroll entry/voucher is created for the current month
Base salary amount 42450 NOK is included
One-time bonus amount 13850 NOK is included
risk_notes: Exact payroll task type is not available in allowed list; using closest match create_voucher.
Sandbox is empty, so employee and payroll prerequisites may need creation first.
Current month is relative and not provided as an explicit ISO date.
Missing required payroll details such as employee birth date, address, tax card, bank account, employment details, and salary type mappings may block execution.
Payroll module/feature may need activation before salary can be processed.
ordered_steps: Enable payroll-related module/settings if not already available via module/settings endpoint
Create employee via employee endpoint with name Arne Aasen and email arne.aasen@example.org
Verify employee has required payroll master data; if missing, collect and update employee endpoint
Create payroll/salary voucher for current month via voucher/payroll-capable endpoint
Add salary line for base salary 42450 NOK
Add salary line for one-time bonus 13850 NOK
Post/save the voucher and confirm it is registered for the intended month

rules: ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex auto-generates VAT and credit postings.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.
